title: •Fear
caption: •Fear (V)
game_text: _When drawn for destiny, may place a non-{alter} Effect on table in owner’s Used Pile._ OR Lose the top card of your Reserve Deck to make a just drawn destiny lost.
lore: “I’m not afraid.” “Oh. You will be. You will be.” One of the lessons Luke learned was that fear of the unknown can be stronger than fear of the known.

Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes and the quote reads “Oh. You will be. You will be.” (wiki has single quotes and drops the second 'You will be.'); curly apostrophe in I’m.
